device.description: 32-channel 20-bit current-input (charge-integrating) delta-sigma ADC with serial output and configuration register
device.note: ddc232.pdf (SBAS331D) p.3-4 specifications (DVDD 2.7-3.6 V, AVDD 4.75-5.25 V, DCLK / CLK_CFG 20 MHz), p.5 BGA pin configuration and descriptions, p.11-12 configuration register write / read-back (DIN_CFG latched on the CLK_CFG falling edge, 12 bits MSB first, read-back = 12-bit configuration + 4-bit revision ID + test pattern, Table 5, Figure 8, Table 6), p.13 Table 7 configuration register (Range 350 pC, Format = 1, Clk_4x = 0, Test = 0 defaults; Version 0 = DDC232C, 1 = DDC232CK), p.14 RESET, p.16 Table 9 (tCMDR cont mode data ready = 1382 +-2 CLK periods), p.20 Table 12 code table (0 % FS = 0000 0001 0000 0000 0000), data retrieval, Figure 17 / Table 13 (no chip select, Input 32 first, DCLK falling edge to valid DOUT 25 ns)

registers.name: CFG
registers.note: p.13 Table 7, written only as a whole 12-bit word on DIN_CFG; bits 5-1 must be 0 (read-only 0 in the model); reset = Range 111 (350 pC), Format 1, Clk_4x 0, Test 0 (defaults); the Version default is not given (0 used)

commands.name: Write configuration (Format = 1)
commands.note: p.11-12: 12 bits on DIN_CFG, MSB first; the optional read-back that follows on DOUT is 12-bit configuration, 4-bit revision ID (value not given: 0000) and the 304-bit test pattern (last 72 bits 30F066012480F69055h), sent twice (640 bits, Table 5)

commands.name: Write configuration (Format = 0)
commands.note: p.11-12, Table 5: read-back 2 x (12 + 4 + 240) = 512 bits, test pattern last 56 bits 30F066012480F6h

pages: p.3-4 (specifications), p.5 (BGA pinout), p.11-12 (configuration register write / read-back, Table 5, Figure 8, Table 6), p.13 (Table 7 configuration register), p.14 (digital interface, RESET), p.16-17 (Tables 9, 10: data-ready timing), p.20 (Table 12 code table, data retrieval, Figure 17, Table 13), p.21 (daisy chain)
notModeled: charge-integrating analog front end (32 dual integrators, VREF, Range full-scale selection, Test mode): the output is always the 0 % FS code (Table 12: 0000 0001 0000 0000 0000 with Format = 1, 0000 0001 0000 0000 with Format = 0), written literally in the frame for all 32 inputs

CONV: in the device every CONV transition (both edges) ends an integration and DVALID goes low tCMDR = 1382 +-2 CLK periods later; the model starts a conversion only on the CONV rising edge (convst edge "rise"), so it reports data every other transition

conversion time = tCMDR at the nominal clock with Clk_4x = 0: 276.8 us (DDC232C, CLK 5 MHz, Version = 0), 138.4 us (DDC232CK, CLK 10 MHz, Version = 1); the CLK pin and the Clk_4x divider are not used by the model; non-continuous mode and power-up states

configuration port: two-wire (CLK_CFG, DIN_CFG) with no chip select, framed by a RESET strobe with CONV low; modeled as a configBus SPI port without cs or miso in a stream frame (each 12 bits is one configuration write); partial writes, the tWTRST / tWTWR 2 ms waits and the CONV-low requirement are not checked

configuration read-back is shifted on DOUT on DCLK rising edges right after the write (modeled as the next DOUT transaction via "next"; the 2-wire DOUT port starts a transaction only when a conversion completes, so the read-back appears with the next DVALID); the 4-bit revision ID value is not given in the datasheet (0000 used)
CLK_CFG mode: the datasheet gives only "latched on the falling edge of CLK_CFG" (mode 1 assumed)
DVALID goes high tPDDCDV after the first DCLK falling edge; the model clears it when the result is read
daisy-chain (Figures 18, 19): after the device's own words DOUT shifts the DIN bits; the model shifts zeros
variants: DDC232C (Version bit 0, 3.125 kSPS) and DDC232CK (Version bit 1, 6.2 kSPS) share the datasheet; DDC112 / DDC114 / DDC118 are separate datasheets with the same retrieval scheme
